name: What if my employer retaliates against me for filing a workers' comp claim?

mainEntity.name: What if my employer retaliates against me for filing a workers' comp claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Employer retaliation for filing a workers' comp claim is illegal. If you experience adverse actions such as termination, demotion, reduction in hours, or harassment after filing a claim, you may have legal recourse. It's crucial to document all instances of alleged retaliation, including dates, times, and specific details. A workers' comp lawyer can help you understand your rights, gather evidence, and pursue a separate claim for wrongful termination or discrimination to protect your job and recover damages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Employer retaliation for filing a workers' comp claim is illegal. Document any adverse actions and consult a lawyer to protect your rights and pursue a claim for wrongful termination or discrimination.
